codeSnippet:
SELECT dept, COUNT(*)
FROM emp
WHERE COUNT(*) > 5
GROUP BY dept;
options: Put WHERE after the GROUP BY

explanation.en: WHERE filters rows before grouping, so aggregates are not allowed there; HAVING filters the groups.

codeSnippet:
SELECT u.name, o.id
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid';
-- users with no paid order vanish
options: Add `GROUP BY u.name` at the end

explanation.en: For unmatched users o.status is NULL, so the WHERE drops them and the LEFT JOIN acts like an inner join.

codeSnippet:
const ids = new Array(3).map((_, i) => i);
console.log(ids); // expected [0, 1, 2]

explanation.en: new Array(3) has empty slots, and map skips holes; filling the array gives map real elements to visit.
